language.name: Aldervale Evening News
language.rationale: This design language conveys the calm, authoritative, and scholarly nature of public-broadcast news for The Aldervale Institute, using a palette derived directly from their brand to ensure a measured and trustworthy on-air presence.

notes: structure and spacing: platform-owned (airy density - 33/46px padding, 16px line gap, at scale 1)
accent: a rule across the top of the panel, one clear space above the words
motion: reveal at measured pace → preset line-reveal
mark field: the mark reads 1.01:1 on this panel (floor 3) - its column carries #f2f4f7, where it reads 13.61:1
